ARCH-CONCIL-01.decision: Dissent and falsification matter more than vote count

ARCH-DEV-01.decision: Working vertical spine before broad hardening

ARCH-HELP-01.decision: ELIOT reduces cognitive and operational load

ARCH-ROLE-01.decision: Observation, interpretation, authorization, and verification are separated

ARCH-ROLE-02.decision: Responsibility follows competence and failure type

ARCH-AUTH-01.decision: Authority is explicit, scoped, and fenced

ARCH-MOD-01.decision: Small living Kernel; local Module failure does not kill the system

ARCH-MOD-02.decision: Depth grows through independently testable Micro-modules; physical size and form remain empirical

ARCH-MOD-03.decision: One causal responsibility: one owner per mutable state, one proof surface, one replacement boundary

ARCH-PORT-01.decision: Organs and execution contours are replaceable; public inheritance transfers, tacit strategy is requalified

ARCH-MEM-02.decision: Semantic fallibility is recoverable through forward revision

ARCH-MEM-03.decision: Derived memory preserves evidence and lineage

ARCH-MEM-04.decision: Retrieval is not reinforcement; forgetting is not belief revision

ARCH-LIFE-01.decision: No semantic teleportation among observation, interpretation, authority, and proof

ARCH-EPI-01.decision: Reality corrects; epistemic positions remain defeasible

ARCH-EPI-02.decision: Theories earn and lose weight through outcomes

ARCH-EPI-03.decision: Exploration cannot confirm itself on the same evidence

ARCH-EPI-04.decision: Coverage requires a declared, frozen, and recheckable denominator

ARCH-UND-01.decision: Load-bearing understanding has a public inspectable form

ARCH-UND-02.decision: Causal understanding is tested by discriminative prediction and outcomes

ARCH-GROUND-01.decision: Models remain tied to tools, graphs, artifacts, and verifiers

ARCH-SELF-01.decision: ELIOT maintains evidence-linked self-knowledge without self-certification

ARCH-CTX-04.decision: Retrieval proposes candidates; Context Compiler admits influence

ARCH-ATTN-01.decision: Critical Attention is state, not a message

ARCH-SKL-01.decision: Skills are concise, intent-dense, and challengeable

ARCH-WDG-02.decision: Watchdog supervises preservation of declared intent, observable outcomes, security, and recovery

ARCH-DRM-01.decision: Dreamer is an AI service, not an owner or authority

ARCH-DRM-02.decision: Dreamer expands hypothesis space and orientation

ARCH-DRM-03.decision: Dreamer agents and swarms are human-governed by budget and policy

ARCH-DRM-04.decision: Researcher acquires, Dreamer interprets, Governor governs

ARCH-SWM-01.decision: Swarm is a bounded, context-minimal staged evidence pipeline

ARCH-SWM-02.decision: Swarm coordination is durable, idempotent, and epoch-fenced

ARCH-LONG-01.decision: Long work lives in durable state

ARCH-FIN-01.decision: Completion is proof-bearing; other finish states remain explicit

ARCH-HUM-01.decision: Human retains value authority and practical control

ARCH-SEC-01.decision: Assume compromise; preserve control and recovery

ARCH-SEC-04.decision: Model output remains a candidate until governed transition

ARCH-PRIV-01.decision: Erasure propagates and is not undone by restore

ARCH-RES-03.decision: Restore or migration cannot resurrect invalid state

ARCH-ORD-01.decision: Parallel where independent; ordered where causal

ARCH-OBS-01.decision: Logs, metrics, audit, and reports are distinct

ARCH-LEARN-01.decision: Learning changes external inheritance through grounded outcomes

ARCH-LEARN-02.decision: Learn online within a task; promote globally only under proof

ARCH-META-01.decision: Self-improvement is advisory, isolated, evidence-driven, and falsifiable

ARCH-DEV-02.decision: Depth grows through independently testable layers, Edge proofs, and Product Pulses
